info.description: XBase searches X (Twitter) through the official X API v2 - no scraping - and returns normalized posts: id, text, author username and name, timestamp, public metrics (likes, reposts, replies, quotes), the post URL, and language. POST /search runs any query in X search grammar over recent posts. POST /news-scan runs curated preset query sets (hiphop; black-news-us; black-news-international, covering the African diaspora worldwide) and returns the merged, de-duplicated posts newest first. Every failure is a structured JSON error, including an explicit 503 when the upstream engine is not configured.
info.title: XBase

get.description: Open endpoint (no proxy secret). Returns service status, the engine state (live, mock, or awaiting_token) with its source note, the preset inventory, limits, and recent request outcomes.

200.description: status, service, version, build, engine {state, source, pricing_note}, presets, limits, endpoints, recent_requests, note

post.description: JSON body: preset (required), one of hiphop, black-news-us, black-news-international. Runs the preset's curated queries against the official X API, merges the results, de-duplicates by post id, and returns them newest first with a per-query count.

200.description: preset, label, queries[], posts_per_query{}, count, posts[] (same normalized shape as /search), _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

post.summary: Run a curated news preset scan

post.description: JSON body: query (required, X search grammar), max_results (optional, default 25, cap 100), hours_back (optional, default 24, cap 168). Returns the query, a count, and the normalized posts newest first.

200.description: query, count, posts[] {id, text, author {username, name}, created_at, metrics {likes, reposts, replies, quotes}, url, lang}, _meta {service, version, engine, latency_ms}

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

429.description: Structured error: x_rate_limited (450 requests per 15 minutes per app upstream)

503.description: Structured error: engine_not_configured (no X Bearer token on the deployment yet)

post.summary: Search recent X posts with any query
